title: Verbal Inspiration Examples
slide_intent: Show a range of verbal possibilities so writers can move from abstract traits to concrete food messages.
strategic_value: Ingredient, product and flame-grilling examples can give Burger King a familiar voice grounded in its food.
demonstration: An introduction at left leads several columns of sample phrases grouped by ingredients, realness, product and fire.
practical_value: Choose a food topic and write sensory, conversational variations while checking claims and clearance.
